svg.title: RV32IMA 5-stage pipeline: datapath and control
svg.text: RV32IMA 5-stage in-order pipeline — datapath and control
Solid: datapath. Dashed grey: control. Dashed red: exception fields (exc, tval). Block names match rtl/DESIGN.md. Memory hierarchy and the PD build: rtl/top_hierarchy.svg.
forward from MEM (ALU / MUL / DIV result)
inputs: rs1/rs2 (ID, EX), rd + late/valid (EX, MEM, WB); causes: imem_wait, mul_busy, div_busy, amo_busy, dmem_wait, redirect_req
outputs: forward_a/b, hold_pc, hold_if_id / id_ex / ex_mem, bubble_if_id / id_ex / ex_mem / mem_wb, redirect
kill: every register <- bubble, PC frozen

Exceptions travel with the instruction: tval is the PC for a fetch fault, the encoding for an illegal instruction and the address for a memory fault; at each First Exc the older exception wins, and the first one to reach WB stops the core (Stop / Fatal).
The control bundle is pipelined like the datapath: each pipeline register keeps only the fields still needed downstream, and each stage taps off its own.
